module_role: Reconciles every M3.0 schedule identity to its source row and to the supplied plan/detail context without treating a repeated schematic or plan appearance as an extra unit. The drawing set has no dedicated control-valve or damper-actuator schedule.

primary_anchors.visual_anchor: M1.0 loft mechanical plan labels existing AHU-1; M3.0 gives its reference-only schedule.
M1.0/M2.0 show existing B-1 context; M3.0 schedule row B-1(E).
M1.0/M2.0 show existing B-2 context; M3.0 schedule row B-2(E).
M1.0 new-work plan labels HWP-1; M4.0 schematic shows HWP 1 (N).
M1.0 new-work plan labels HWP-2; M4.0 schematic shows HWP 2 (N).
M1.0 new-work plan labels BP-1 and directs new boiler-pump installation.
M1.0 new-work plan labels BP-2 and directs new boiler-pump installation.
M1.0 new-work plan labels CWP-1; M4.1 schematic shows CWP 1 (N).
M1.0 new-work plan labels CWP-2; M4.1 schematic shows CWP 2 (N).
M1.0 new-work plan labels VFD-1; M4.0 schematic shows VFD 1 (N).
M1.0 new-work plan labels VFD-2; M4.0 schematic shows VFD 2 (N).

plan_and_detail_reconciliation.finding: DISCONNECT AND REMOVE EXISTING HOT WATER PUMPS. The schedule's HWP-1/HWP-2 are new replacement scope, not retained existing pumps.
DISCONNECT AND REMOVE EXISTING CHILLED WATER PUMPS. The schedule's CWP-1/CWP-2 are new replacement scope, not retained existing pumps.
INSTALL NEW BOILER PUMP ON RETURN SIDE; this supports BP-1/BP-2 new-schedule scope but does not rewrite the printed BP-2 schedule's B-1 area-served cell.
CONNECT NEW CHILLED WATER LOOP PUMPS TO EXISTING piping; this supports CWP-1/CWP-2 new-schedule scope.
INSTALL NEW 3-WAY VALVE ON EXISTING AHU-1 heating-water connection and balance valve to 48 GPM. It is a design note, not a full valve schedule or count.

The new heating-coil piping detail contains a NEW 3-WAY CONTROL VALVE and a flow control valve with P/T ports, union and shut-off valve. No valve tag, manufacturer, actuator torque, or schedule quantity is printed.

control_valve_schedule.note: The project provides individual valve notes/details and M4.0 legend symbols, not a schedule.

damper_actuator_schedule.note: M4.0 defines DA in the controls legend; no damper/actuator schedule appears in the supplied set.

source_conflicts.finding: BP-1 and BP-2 both print area served as BOILER PUMP (B-1). The plan/detail context shows two existing boiler locations, but this record preserves the BP-2 printed schedule cell and does not silently correct it to B-2.
